items.name: Breaking
items.description: I break(dance) in my free time.
Right now I'm trying to work on windmills. I think it's a real rite of passage for anyone who wants to stick with it.
My footwork has been cleaner lately, but I want to train for speed and flow with my other moves.
I've also been trying out popping and locking. Hopefully I can stick to them in the future.
I've been getting into sketching. Mainly just line art.
I've been alternating going through linework tutorials and just doodling faces I like.
When I get good enough I plan to add some doodles to this website, so stay tuned...
